purpose: Learn weights daily and seek high win rate subject to positive net expectancy, profit factor, sample size and drawdown constraints. No guarantee that any model passes.
trailRule: Only after completed5m profit>=1R move stop toward fee-inclusive breakeven; after>=1.5R use2ATR5m trail; exit on completed15m EMA8/21 reversal. No fixed target for trail profile.
carryRule: At14:55/02:25, conditional mode holds only if causal15/60m technical carry score>=80; explicit setup-independent score30+30+20+10+10; no learned probability fed back into labels.
classifier: L2 regularized logistic regression; train-only standardization; rare/constant features disabled; coefficients learned, not hand-scored; probabilities require out-of-sample calibration
retrain: Every trading day using only prior windows; next-day OOS continuous account, old trade keeps original exit profile when daily model changes
selectionStress: Extra120CNY per round trip on same fills, separately from final full price/margin stress
historicalStatus: AU2612 history has already been inspected forv1; v2 daily walk-forward is retrospective protocol validation, not untouched prospective evidence. New dates after2026-11-06 are prospective.
informationPolicy: Current-vintage public FRED with DST/holiday-aware delayed availability proxies. No fabricated historical geopolitics/news sentiment. Missing and sparse factors remain disclosed.
priorVersionObserved: v2.0 lost28680CNY;v2.1 no candidates. Preserved. v2.2 fixes conflating confidence index with win probability and replaces average-win>=loss with positive expectancy/PF and bounded tail payout.
drawdownStopPolicy: Research safety assumption: planned risk must fit remaining15000CNY drawdown budget; on breach try exit and halt new entries for this version; gaps may exceed. No automatic restart.
eventRisk: FOMC/minutes2h before/after;CPI/NFP/PCE/GDP1h;next24h event or>12h nontrading gap forbids carry; original+revised dates where verified.
technicalFrequency: Causal daily completed/developing state and1/5/15/60m; everyminute patterns; stop/target everyminute; train-only correlation pruning>=.95
confidenceDefinition: 60+40*(p-pBE)/(1-pBE) clipped60-99 only for p>=pBE; pBE from train-only profile average win/loss. Index is economic signal strength, NOT probability. Probability separately calibrated.
